'''Leafhunter''' is a she-[[wolf]], pack leader and mate to [[Feather (wolf)|Feather]].

==Activities==
[[Perrin Aybara]] contacts Leafhunter's pack when he tries to identify a scent. The wolves of Leafhunter's pack break contact one by one, as they know the sent, that of the [[Darkhound]]s. She is the last wolf to maintain the link and she tells Perrin that the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Hunt]] is coming.{{ref/book|10|5}}
